Traditional Tantra • Self-Mastery • Embodiment • Spiritual Growth

We’re delighted to welcome Jen Hamilton of Sanctuary of Self to The Wellness Collective.
Jen is a Tantra Teacher & Facilitator, Self-Mastery Mentor, Coach, Podcast Host, Author, Writer and Speaker, and the founder and visionary behind Sanctuary of Self.

Her work combines Traditional Tantra, self-mastery, mentoring, coaching, hypnotherapy, spiritual development, energetic practices and embodied awareness to support people in developing a deeper relationship with themselves, their bodies, their relationships and their sense of purpose.

Jen’s journey in the spiritual and personal-development space began in 2006. Since then she has studied and worked across areas including psychic development, Reiki, ThetaHealing, the Melchizedek Method, Clinical Hypnotherapy, Strategic Psychotherapy, NLP, Past Life Regression Therapy and Tantra.

She has supported hundreds of clients internationally through private mentoring, coaching, women's circles, cacao ceremonies, online programs, immersive experiences and Tantra.

Jen is based in Capalaba on Brisbane's bayside and offers selected services both in person and online.


✨ JEN'S OFFERINGS


🌹 TANTRA SESSIONS

Jen offers Traditional Tantra sessions for individuals and couples, with a focus on self-awareness, embodiment, conscious connection, breath, presence, intimacy and personal growth.

Individual Tantra Session
$269 | 1.5 hours
A one-to-one Tantra experience for people wanting to deepen their relationship with themselves, their body and their inner life force.
5 sessions — 5% discount
10 sessions — 10% discount

An initial consultation is required for new clients.
Introductory consultation: $150 | 1 hour
Available in person in Brisbane's Bayside.


💕 Couples Tantra Session
$289 | 1.5 hours

A consciously facilitated experience for couples wanting to deepen connection, intimacy, communication, trust and emotional safety.
Sessions are fully clothed and consent-led, with the focus on conscious connection rather than sexual technique.
5 sessions — 5% discount
10 sessions — 10% discount

An initial consultation is required before booking.
Introductory consultation: $150 | 1 hour
Available in person in Brisbane's Bayside.


🌺 TANTRIC AWAKENING JOURNEY
$1,497 | 8 x 1:1 sessions
Introductory cons﻿ultation: $150 | 1 hour

A structured eight-session journey exploring Tantra, energetic principles and the chakra system.
The journey works with areas including:
• Body awareness
• Emotional regulation
• Communication
• Sensuality
• Self-awareness
• Energetic awareness
• Conscious connection
• Inner clarity
The programme is suitable for beginners as well as people wanting to deepen their existing Tantra practice.
Includes:
Complimentary An Mo Massage valued at $327

Payment plans are available.
An initial consultation is required.


🌸 AN MO MASSAGE
$327 | 2 hours
Introductory cons﻿ultation: $150 | 1 hour

Includes Tantra Session + An Mo Massage
An Mo is a Tantric bodywork practice incorporating intentional touch, gentle movement, breath awareness and energetic work.
The experience is centred around relaxation, embodiment, self-connection and awareness of the body's energy.
An Mo is strictly non-sexual.
There is no genital touch, and the genitals remain covered throughout the massage.
An Mo is available to women and men. Men must complete five individual Tantra sessions before An Mo Massage is offered.
New clients require an introductory consultation.
Available in person in Brisbane's Bayside.


💫 SENSUAL BLISS EXPERIENCE
$397 | 3 hours
Introductor﻿y consultation: $150 | 1 hour

A three-hour sensual and soulful experience incorporating:
• An Mo Tantric Body Massage
• Crystal bowl sound healing
• Cacao ceremony
• Sensory experiences
• Conscious relaxation and embodiment
This is a non-sexual but sensual experience designed around relaxation, sensory awareness, embodiment and self-connection.
Men may access this offering after completing five individual sessions.
New clients require an introductory consultation.
Available in person in Brisbane's Bayside.


💕 COUPLES TANTRIC MENTORING
Introductory Session: $229

Couples Tantric Mentoring is designed for people wanting to explore deeper communication, connection, intimacy and conscious relating.
The work combines conversation, Tantra, embodiment practices and practical mentoring.
Sessions may explore:
• Communication
• Emotional connection
• Intimacy
• Trust
• Relationship patterns
• Conscious relating
• Embodiment
• Personal clarity
• Connection with yourself and your partner

Available in person in Capalaba or online via Zoom.
The initial session is used to understand where you are and determine the most appropriate pathway forward. Further options are discussed following the initial session.


🌱 THE FLOURISH COLLECTIVE
$44/month introductory price
Usually $99/month

A month-to-month online self-mastery membership for people wanting ongoing support with personal growth, alignment, purpose and self-love.
Membership includes:
• Monthly live Zoom masterclass
• Access to the online community
• Workbooks
• Meditations
• Videos
• Self-paced practices
• Growing library of resources
• Access to previous monthly content
There is no lock-in contract.
2026 monthly themes include:
January: Values Based Living
February: Connect with Your Higher Self
March: Understanding Your Beautiful Mind
April: Re-wiring Beliefs
May: Sacred Sexuality
June: Conscious Relationships
July: Walking a Spiritual Path
August: Attitude of Gratitude
September: Manifestation Mastery
October: Sacred Self Pleasure
November: The Ultimate Glow Up
December: Life Stocktake


🌿 THE GARDEN OF GROWTH
From $899

A self-paced self-mastery programme designed around self-discovery, personal growth and alignment.
The programme provides resources and practices that can be worked through at your own pace.
Personalised coaching can also be added for people wanting deeper guidance and support.
Participants who complete the full journey may have the opportunity to explore becoming a Self Mastery Coach with Sanctuary of Self, with further mentoring from Jen.
Includes:
Complimentary membership to The Flourish Collective
The programme has different pathways/phases, so contact Jen to determine the most appropriate starting point and current package price.


🧠 ONE-OFF SELF-MASTERY SESSION
$220 per hour
1–4 hours available

A private session with Jen for people wanting clarity, direction, support or a space to explore a particular area of their life.
Depending on what you need, sessions may incorporate:
• Mentoring
• Coaching
• Subconscious exploration
• Intuitive guidance
• Self-inquiry
• Embodiment practices
• Practical direction
A paid introductory session is required before beginning private ongoing work.


🔮 PAST LIFE REGRESSION THERAPY
Contact Jen for current pricing

Past Life Regression Therapy is available in person in Capalaba, Brisbane.
The approach uses guided hypnosis to explore experiences understood through the framework of past lives and reincarnation.
Jen has training in Past Life Regression Therapy and incorporates this work within her broader self-mastery and spiritual-development practice.
Please contact Jen directly for current pricing, availability and suitability.


🌟 PRIVATE 1:1 MENTORING WITH JEN
3-month or 6-month private mentoring journeys
Contact Jen for current investment

Private mentoring is designed for people wanting deeper, longer-term support with their personal development, practitioner journey, spiritual growth or professional direction.

It is particularly suited to:
• Aspiring Tantra practitioners
• Existing Tantra practitioners
• Coaches
• Facilitators
• Holistic practitioners
• Future Self Mastery Coaches

Mentoring is available in person in Capalaba or online via Zoom.

All new clients begin with a paid Intro Session so Jen can understand what you're seeking and determine whether a 3-month or 6-month journey is the right fit.

Contact Jen directly for current pricing and package details.


🌹 INTERNATIONALLY CERTIFIED TANTRA TRAINING
Module 1 + 2

A comprehensive three-day Tantra and Esoteric Philosophy training covering foundational Tantra teachings, self-awareness, consciousness, the chakra system, sexual energy, conscious relationships, communication, meditation, boundaries and An Mo Tantric Massage.

Module 1 — Know Thyself
Explores:
• Tantra and Esoteric Philosophy
• Higher Self and personality
• Consciousness
• Spiritual development
• Practices and meditation
• Self-awareness

Module 2 — Chakra System & Tantric Energy
Explores:
• Chakra system
• Sexual energy
• Cultivation of life-force energy
• Conscious communication
• Boundaries
• Sacred Tantra for men, women and couples
• An Mo Sensual Tantric Massage
Students learn both to give and receive An Mo Massage within the training.

The training is available Australia-wide.

Current payment options:

$1,597 AUD when paid in full

Payment plan available with:
$297 non-refundable deposit + 4 fortnightly payments

Lunch and refreshments are included during the training.
Training dates and formats vary, so contact Jen directly for upcoming dates.


🌺 THE SANCTUARY OF US
$97

A couples-focused offering designed to create intentional space for connection, intimacy and conscious relating.
The programme is designed to help couples slow down, reconnect and explore their relationship through a more conscious and embodied approach.
Contact Jen fo﻿r more details.
